description: gtfs2emis is an R package from Brazil's Institute for Applied Economic Research for estimating emissions from scheduled public transport. It turns General Transit Feed Specification routes and schedules into vehicle space-time positions and combines them with fleet characteristics and emission-factor models. Inputs are GTFS data, vehicle age, fuel or technology information, and a selected pollutant method; outputs are trip-, route-, time- or grid-level emissions tables. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the supplied feed; the README includes examples from Curitiba, Detroit and Dublin. The package DESCRIPTION states MIT plus a licence file, and the code is available on CRAN. A limitation is that results depend on fleet-allocation assumptions and the chosen factor model, and hot-exhaust estimates do not cover every life-cycle effect. The tool prepares emissions inputs for transit planning and air-quality simulations. It is related to transport demand models but is not a timetable generator. No GTFS feed or emissions run was obtained.
